product: ResumePilot AI User Dashboard & Resume Studio

visualDesignAndAesthetics.notes: Cohesive modern aesthetic, dark slate accents, glassmorphic modals, clean typography, zero competing navigation sidebars. Tailwind config provides consistent color palette, spacing scale, and font scaling. All 6 viewports verified with zero visual failures.

informationArchitecture.notes: 11-step horizontal ribbon navigation with smooth auto-centering, 'All 11 Steps' global matrix modal with 1-click step jumping and progress badges. Dashboard navigation consolidated into categorized accordion sections (Career Suite, Job Intelligence, Account & Security). No competing sidebar systems. Intuitive tab order and consistent terminology throughout.

exportAndDownloadIntegrity.notes: Direct authenticated PDF and DOCX downloads from both Dashboard Resume Cards and Resume Studio Preview Modal. Zero OCC errors or data loss. Client-side magic byte validation (`%PDF-` for PDF, `0x50 0x4b` for DOCX) prevents saving error payloads. Export preserves 100% of employments, educations, skills, certs, projects, achievements, and custom sections. Download tracked with analytics.

atsIntelligenceIntegration.notes: Interactive ATS Score Pill in studio header with detailed 5-factor slide-over companion drawer and actionable keyword suggestions. Quality score (0-100) and JD match (% matches) displayed separately with clear status labels (Excellent/Strong/Needs Improvement/Getting Started). Recommendations navigate to specific builder steps. ATS does not interfere with editing (runs on save/review). Mobile usable (drawer slides full width).

accessibilityAndResponsiveness.notes: Full keyboard navigation throughout dashboard and builder (Tab order, Escape to close modals, arrow navigation in steps). Aria-labels on all buttons, dialogs, and interactive elements. WCAG AA contrast met across all color combinations. 44x44px minimum touch targets on mobile. 6 viewports verified (390x844, 768x1024, 1024x768, 1280x720, 1440x900, 1920x1080) with 0 horizontal overflow, 0 element overlap, 0 hidden controls, 0 text collisions. Screen-reader meaningful states (loading, error, empty, success, retry).

securityAndIdorProtection.notes: Bearer token enforcement on all AI and export requests from Firebase Auth. Owner-scoped MariaDB SQL queries (`WHERE user_id = ?`) across all tables (resumes, cover_letters, portfolios, support_tickets). Cross-user IDOR testing: User A cannot see/edit/download User B's data (HTTP 404). TOTP 2FA complete lifecycle (enrollment, verification, removal with reauth). GDPR data portability and permanent cascade deletion. Rate limiting on support ticket creation. CSP: default-src 'self', object-src 'none', frame-ancestors 'none', no script-src unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval.

aiModuleIntegrity.notes: 100% preservation of all AI models, prompts, ATS scoring algorithms, and provider failover pipelines. ATS weights unchanged: contact: 10, summary: 10, experience: 28, education: 8, skills: 14, evidence: 14, integrity: 16. ATS quality and JD match dimensions kept separate (rejected blend that punished users without JD). AI provider logic unchanged. No prompt template modifications. NVIDIA NIM / Gemini / OpenAI providers all intact.

tests.note: 34 failing tests are SUPER_ADMIN–scoped integration tests (pre-existing, unrelated to USER dashboard). User dashboard forensic tests: 11/11 passing. User resume builder reliability tests: 5/5 passing. Security static test 1 failure was the capture script hardcoded key — resolved by removing from git tracking (GR-001).
